scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && pnpm generate && pnpm --parallel --filter @kompak/shared --filter web --filter api dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm generate && pnpm -r --filter "!@kompak/shared" build
scripts.lint: pnpm build:shared && pnpm generate && pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm generate && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:shared && pnpm generate && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:shared && pnpm generate && pnpm --filter api test:e2e
